description: You are a paralegal at a corporate law firm. Open /home/ga/Documents/vendor_agreement_draft.docx, which is a draft Vendor Services Agreement between CloudFirst Industries, LLC and Meridian Technology Solutions, Inc. The document has been hastily drafted and contains numerous formatting and structural issues that must be corrected before the supervising partner reviews it. Clean up the document to meet professional legal document standards. Issues include: inconsistent heading hierarchy across sections, the vendor's name is referenced inconsistently throughout (sometimes abbreviated, sometimes in all-caps, sometimes the full legal name), the Definitions section is incomplete (terms like 'Deliverables', 'Service Level Agreement', and 'Term' are used in the body but never defined), the deliverables table has no professional formatting, some body paragraphs have incorrect alignment, certain sections have spurious italic or bold formatting, and the document is missing a signature block. Produce a clean, professional legal document and save it.

metadata.data_source: Standard vendor services agreement template based on ABA Model Agreements
